$comment: Session AK Part 1c. The licence and attribution of each generic-food source, read on the official pages on 2026-10-31. build-generic-db.mjs copies name, licence, licenceUrl, attribution, notice and link into apps/web/public/food-generic/manifest.json and each <source>-v1.json, which the app shows beside every result. A source whose `verified` is false is never built: verify its licence on the official page, record the URL and the exact text here, then set it to true. NEVO is excluded: its conditions forbid redistribution.

ciqual.name: Ciqual 2025 (ANSES, France)
ciqual.publisher: Agence nationale de sécurité sanitaire de l'alimentation, de l'environnement et du travail (Anses)
ciqual.attribution: Anses. 2025. Table de composition nutritionnelle des aliments Ciqual
ciqual.notice: Ciqual 2025, last updated 2025-11-19 (files of 2025-11-03), Licence Ouverte / Etalab 2.0. ZIGoals keeps selected nutrients and converts them to its units; traces and values given as "less than" are shown as unknown.
evidence: The same metadata, notesText: "Elles peuvent être reproduites, obligatoirement avec la référence explicite à la source : \"Anses. 2025. Table de composition nutritionnelle des aliments Ciqual\""

Etalab 2.0 (https://spdx.org/licenses/etalab-2.0.html): mention the paternity of the information: its source (at least the licensor's name) and the date of its last update; a hyperlink to the source is enough when the attribution is effectively shown

cofid.name: McCance and Widdowson's Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset 2021 (CoFID, UK)
cofid.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
cofid.notice: McCance and Widdowson's The Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset 2021, Public Health England, © Crown copyright 2021. ZIGoals keeps selected nutrients and converts them to its units; trace (Tr) and not-known (N) values are shown as unknown; alcoholic drinks (given per 100 ml) are left out.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/composition-of-foods-integrated-dataset-cofid — From: Public Health England; last updated 19 March 2021; footer: "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated"

https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/ — "If the Information Provider does not provide a specific attribution statement, you must use the following: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0."
The 2021 user guide (same page): "© Crown copyright 2021"; "Nutrient values are expressed per 100g of the food except in the case of alcoholic beverages which are presented per 100ml."

fineli.name: Fineli, the Finnish food composition database (THL, Finland)
fineli.publisher: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
fineli.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) — UNVERIFIED
fineli.attribution: UNVERIFIED — read the exact attribution on https://fineli.fi/fineli/en/avoin-data before setting verified to true
fineli.notice: Fineli, Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL). ZIGoals keeps selected nutrients and converts them to its units (changes made).
evidence: 2026-10-31: every fineli.fi page answered 403 with `cf-mitigated: challenge` (a Cloudflare browser challenge) from this sandbox, so the licence page and the open-data files could not be read.
avoindata.suomi.fi lists 'THL Open Data' (thl-n-avoin-data) under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 and names Fineli among its topics; that is the THL collection, not Fineli's own page.

download.expected: The open-data zip (semicolon-separated CSV files: food.csv, component.csv, component_value.csv, foodname_EN.csv, foodname_FI.csv); give it to the build with --from <dir>/fineli/
